title: GPT-6 Astra Generates Autonomous Lean 4 Proof of the 43-Year-Old Dittert–Hajek Permanent Conjecture
aiSystem: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra (Epoch AI LeanOpenProblems Harness)
whyItMatters: GPT-6 Astra autonomously produced a Lean 4 proof of the 1983 Dittert–Hajek matrix permanent conjecture across all dimensions n ≥ 2 (without seeing summer 2026 preprints past its April cutoff), adding to Epoch AI’s September 2026 Lean wave.
summary: Released on September 10, 2026 by Tom Adamczewski (Epoch AI) via the open-source tadamcz/dittert Lean 4 repository alongside his Köthe, Smale Mean Value, and Ibragimov–Iosifescu runs, OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra autonomously generated a complete Lean 4 proof of the 1983 Dittert (Dittert–Hajek) conjecture in matrix combinatorics. Generalizing the famous van der Waerden permanent theorem from doubly stochastic matrices to the entire simplex of nonnegative n × n real matrices whose entries sum to n, Dittert’s conjecture asserts that the functional ∏ r_i + ∏ c_j − per(A) is uniquely maximized by the uniform matrix J_n. Because GPT-6 Astra’s April 2026 training cutoff predated independent summer 2026 preprints closing remaining small dimensions, the result demonstrated independent autonomous theorem proving and Lean formalization on a 43-year-old open problem.
technicalHighlights: Produced a Lean 4 formal proof of the full Dittert–Hajek matrix permanent inequality for all dimensions n ≥ 2, generalizing van der Waerden’s theorem.
Generated autonomously by GPT-6 Astra (whose April 2026 knowledge cutoff preceded independent summer 2026 preprints on remaining dimensions).
Published with complete Lean 4 source code, mathematical exposition, and verification logs at github.com/tadamcz/dittert.
caveats: Tom Adamczewski explicitly cautioned that while Lean compiled the proof and AI auditors deemed the formalization faithful, independent human domain-expert verification of statement fidelity and exposition remains pending; independent preprints also resolved remaining dimensions of Dittert’s conjecture in summer 2026.

scoreRationale.velocity: Autonomously constructed and formalized a full-dimension proof in Lean 4 within days via Epoch AI’s evaluation harness.
